verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 21.3
verses.english: Linked Discourses 21.3

verses.pali: 1. Bhikkhuvagga
verses.english: 1. Monks

verses.pali: Ghaṭasutta
verses.english: A Mound of Salt

verses.pali: Evaṁ me sutaṁ—
verses.english: So I have heard.

verses.pali: ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno rājagahe viharanti veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe ekavihāre.
verses.english: At that time Venerables Sāriputta and Moggallāna were staying near Rājagaha, in the Bamboo Grove, the squirrels’ feeding ground.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then in the late afternoon, Venerable Sāriputta came out of retreat, went to Venerable Moggallāna, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṁ mahāmoggallānaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, Sāriputta sat down to one side, and said to Mahāmoggallāna:

verses.pali: “Vippasannāni kho te, āvuso moggallāna, indriyāni;
verses.english: “Reverend Moggallāna, your faculties are so very clear, and your complexion is pure and bright.

verses.pali: parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto santena nūnāyasmā mahāmoggallāno ajja vihārena vihāsī”ti.
verses.english: Have you spent the day in a peaceful meditation?”

verses.pali: “Oḷārikena khvāhaṁ, āvuso, ajja vihārena vihāsiṁ.
verses.english: “Reverend, I’ve spent the day in a coarse meditation.

verses.pali: Api ca me ahosi dhammī kathā”ti.
verses.english: But I have had some Dhamma talk.”

verses.pali: “Kena saddhiṁ panāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa ahosi dhammī kathā”ti?
verses.english: “Who did you have a Dhamma talk with?”

verses.pali: “Bhagavatā kho me, āvuso, saddhiṁ ahosi dhammī kathā”ti.
verses.english: “With the Buddha.”

verses.pali: “Dūre kho, āvuso, bhagavā etarahi sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
verses.english: “But Reverend, the Buddha is far away. He’s staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

verses.pali: Kiṁ nu kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavantaṁ iddhiyā upasaṅkami;
verses.english: Did you go to him with your psychic power,

verses.pali: udāhu bhagavā āyasmantaṁ mahāmoggallānaṁ iddhiyā upasaṅkamī”ti?
verses.english: or did he come to you?”

verses.pali: “Na khvāhaṁ, āvuso, bhagavantaṁ iddhiyā upasaṅkamiṁ;
verses.english: “No reverend, I didn’t go to him with my psychic power,

verses.pali: napi maṁ bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkami.
verses.english: nor did he come to me.

verses.pali: Api ca me yāvatā bhagavā ettāvatā dibbacakkhu visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātu.
verses.english: Rather, the Buddha cleared his clairvoyance and clairaudience towards me,

verses.pali: Bhagavatopi yāvatāhaṁ ettāvatā dibbacakkhu visujjhi dibbā ca sotadhātū”ti.
verses.english: and I cleared my clairvoyance and clairaudience towards him.”

verses.pali: “Yathākathaṁ panāyasmato mahāmoggallānassa bhagavatā saddhiṁ ahosi dhammī kathā”ti?
verses.english: “But what manner of Dhamma talk did you have together?”

verses.pali: “Idhāhaṁ, āvuso, bhagavantaṁ etadavocaṁ:
verses.english: “Well, reverend, I said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: ‘āraddhavīriyo āraddhavīriyoti, bhante, vuccati.
verses.english: ‘Sir, they speak of one who is energetic.

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, āraddhavīriyo hotī’ti?
verses.english: How is an energetic person defined?’

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, maṁ, āvuso, bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: When I said this, the Buddha said,

verses.pali: ‘idha, moggallāna, bhikkhu āraddhavīriyo viharati—
verses.english: ‘Moggallāna, it’s when a mendicant lives with energy roused up:

verses.pali: kāmaṁ taco ca nhāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upassussatu maṁsalohitaṁ, yaṁ taṁ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṁ na taṁ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṁ bhavissatīti.
verses.english: “Gladly, let only skin, sinews, and bones remain! Let the flesh and blood waste away in my body! I will not stop trying until I have achieved what is possible by human strength, energy, and vigor.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, moggallāna, āraddhavīriyo hotī’ti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is energetic.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho me, āvuso, bhagavatā saddhiṁ ahosi dhammī kathā”ti.
verses.english: That’s the Dhamma talk I had together with the Buddha.”

verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, himavato pabbatarājassa parittā pāsāṇasakkharā yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya;
verses.english: “Reverend, next to Venerable Mahāmoggallāna I’m like a few pieces of gravel next to the Himalayas, the king of mountains.

verses.pali: evameva kho mayaṁ āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya.
Āyasmā hi mahāmoggallāno mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo ākaṅkhamāno kappaṁ tiṭṭheyyā”ti.
verses.english: Venerable Mahāmoggallāna is so mighty and powerful he could, if he wished, live on for the proper lifespan.”

verses.pali: “Seyyathāpi, āvuso, mahatiyā loṇaghaṭāya parittā loṇasakkharāya yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya;
verses.english: “Reverend, next to Venerable Sāriputta I’m like a few grains of salt next to a mound of salt.

verses.pali: evameva kho mayaṁ āyasmato sāriputtassa yāvadeva upanikkhepanamattāya.
Āyasmā hi sāriputto bhagavatā anekapariyāyena thomito vaṇṇito pasattho:
verses.english: Venerable Sāriputta has been commended, complimented, and praised by the Buddha:

verses.pali: ‘Sāriputtova paññāya,
verses.english: ‘Sāriputta is full of wisdom,

verses.pali: sīlena upasamena ca;
verses.english: ethics, and peace.

verses.pali: Yopi pāraṅgato bhikkhu,
verses.english: Even a mendicant who has crossed over

verses.pali: etāvaparamo siyā’”ti.
verses.english: might at best equal him.’”

verses.pali: Itiha te ubho mahānāgā aññamaññassa subhāsitaṁ sulapitaṁ samanumodiṁsūti.
verses.english: And so these two spiritual giants agreed with each others’ fine words.

verses.pali: Tatiyaṁ.
